name: ensono-github-actions
description: Repo holds the custom tasks for Github Actions

scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run --sort --filter='@ensono-actions/*' --no-bail build
scripts.clean:local: pnpm store prune && pnpm -r exec -- rm -rf node_modules dist build && rm -rf ./node_modules
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && tsc --noEmit -p actions-lib-utils/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p eirctl-setup/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p playground-echo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p process-json/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.jest.json

author: EnsonoOrg
